method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a rectangle-like corner F-A-C-G: FA is horizontal and GC is horizontal, so FA ∥ GC; FG is perpendicular to FA, and triangle AFG is formed by AF, FG, and GA. From the text, m∠AGC = 40°. Since FA ∥ GC and GA is a transversal, the angle between GA and GC equals the corresponding/alternate interior angle between GA and AF, so ∠GAF = 40°. In triangle AFG, ∠AFG = 90° from the right-angle marker at F. Therefore ∠FGA, which is labeled ∠2, equals 180 − 90 − 40 = 50. The given m∠DGF = 53° is not needed.
